[[File:Darth_Viluss_writings.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Vilus's writings]]
The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vilus]] produced more than three thousand volumes of '''writings''' during his life. The original copy of the writings was owned by [[Darth Thanaton]] and stored in his [[Darth Thanaton's private library|private library]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The public copy was doctored by Thanaton, who had volume 2,397 replaced with a duplicate of volume 2,455. After discovering the forgery, Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] had to break into Thanaton's library to access the original writings.
